name: terminal-mod
description: /trm opens a real terminal (PTY) pane in the workspace folder: your shell, full-screen apps, colours

shell.title: Shell
shell.description: Shell to run (pwsh, powershell, cmd, bash, zsh, fish or a full path). Empty picks pwsh/powershell on Windows, your login shell on macOS

node.title: Node.js
node.description: Path to node (18+) for the PTY host. Empty finds it on PATH (on macOS through your login shell)
